strong_correlation.instruction: Variables exhibit sufficient spatial cross-correlation (I_xy=0.476, rho=0.940) to justify bivariate representation.

weak_correlation.instruction: Weak spatial cross-correlation detected (I_xy=0.116, rho=0.314). Bivariate map approved with mandatory interpretive annotation. Class outlines and correlation statistic must be displayed.

independent_variables.instruction: Variables exhibit no meaningful spatial cross-correlation (I_xy=-0.025, rho=0.012). MANDATED ALTERNATIVE: Generate side-by-side univariate choropleth maps. Do not produce a bivariate map.
